reviews.title: very great power supply
reviews.comment: The Corsair RM1000E is an excellent power supply. When I bought it, it was basically brand new-despite being listed as refurbished, it still had that "brand new" smell and showed no signs of prior use. It comes with all the necessary cables, including the new power connector for the latest graphics cards, although I personally didn't need it since my GPU only uses a six-pin connector. Overall, I've had a great experience with Corsair. My previous PSU was a CX-750M, which I've had for 8-10 years. It outperformed every other power supply I've owned, so I already trusted the brand. The RM1000E is very quiet during operation, and at $98 (plus tax), it's an excellent value for a 1000-watt unit. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable, high-quality power supply. so anybody looking for this power supplies The installation is easy that's with any power supplies plus it's fully modular and looks really good and the functionality of it is better than my old power supply

reviews.title: Solid power, budget friendly and small in stature
reviews.comment: Solid power power supply for the money. My custom water cooling sprung a leak and drown my Corsair 1000i. I purchased this 1000e on short notice to get me buy. I just unhooked the old PSU and installed this one hoping I didnt have to tear all the cableing out and re-run it all. Everything hooked right up amd powered on and I've been running this new PSU for about a month now with now issues. Its a great budget friendly PSU and would recommend it to anyone!

reviews.title: Easy to install
reviews.comment: It was easy to swap out my 850e with this RM1000e. While the 850e could probably have handled the 5060 Ti and the 5080 and the 7950x3d, I had another PC that needed the 850e. I left all the cables from the 850e in place.... adding only the special 12pin connector that the 5080 requires.
